channel.title: Nº 4 April 2016 on My New Hugo Project
channel.description: Recent content in Nº 4 April 2016 on My New Hugo Project

item.title: Editorial
item.description: Editorial of Volume 4 of the Consorseguros Digital Magazine, covering seismic activity in the Iberian Peninsula following the Alboran Sea earthquake, the Paris Climate Conference (COP-21) and its impact on natural disaster insurance, and the Register of Compulsory Insurance.

item.title: Register of Compulsory Insurance [Registro de Seguros Obligatorios] kept by the Consorcio de Compensación de Seguros
item.description: Overview of the legal framework, purpose, public access, and operation of the Register of Compulsory Insurance managed by the Consorcio de Compensación de Seguros.

item.title: Earthquakes in Spain. Recent activity in the Alborán Sea
item.description: Analysis of the tectonic structures and seismic processes affecting the Iberian Peninsula, historical review of major earthquakes in Spain over the last 500 years, and study of the recent seismic activity in the southern Alborán Sea.

item.title: Climate change and insurance: a many-sided interrelationship
item.description: Analysis of climate change projections, extreme weather attribution, the role of the insurance sector in adaptation and mitigation, and Spain’s extraordinary risk coverage scheme managed by the Consorcio de Compensación de Seguros.

item.title: Impact of climate change on natural disaster insurance in France
item.description: Modelling exercise by Caisse Centrale de Réassurance and Météo France on the evolution until 2050 of the main climatic risks covered by the French Cat Nat system and its future capacity.

item.title: The Paris climate change summit: a success for multilateralism
item.description: Analysis of the Paris Climate Change Conference (COP21), the nine core pillars of the Paris Agreement, climate finance mobilization, non-governmental action, and the role of the European Union.

item.title: Forecasts of the economic impacts of climate change
item.description: Joint review of the JRC PESETA II report (2014) and the OECD report (2015) on quantitative sector-by-sector and global economic projections of climate change impacts.

item.title: Motor vehicle civil liability. Traffic events
item.description: Review of José A. Badillo Arias’s monograph (Aranzadi, April 2016) on the historical, regulatory, and case-law evolution of motor vehicle civil liability and the concepts of motor vehicle and traffic events.

item.title: Jurisprudence about the Consorcio de Compensación de Seguros. Commentary on the judgment of the Supreme Court of 5 September 2011
item.description: Case-law commentary on the Supreme Court judgment of 5 September 2011 regarding the Consorcio de Compensación de Seguros’s exemption from posting appeal deposits under Article 12 of the LAJEIP and its effects on jointly liable codefendants.

item.title: The AGERS natural disasters handbook
item.description: Review of the Natural Disasters Handbook published by AGERS (presented on 2 December 2015), focusing on risk management and the role of the Consorcio de Compensación de Seguros in Spain.

item.title: Editors Board
item.description: The Consorcio de Compensación de Seguros digital magazine “Consorseguros” (CCS) is published every six months, its content particularly addressing matters related to the Consorcio’s activities in various fields of insurance, reflecting on and analysing them.
